review_findings.required_fix: Reject getter/setter descriptors during closed-shape inspection before validators read fields, and preflight request data before any field validation. Add an allowed-field getter regression through bindHumanSelection and buildRecommendation that asserts the getter remains uncalled.
review_findings.reason: bindHumanSelection calls validateRequestClosed(request) before checkAcyclicAndSafe(request). The schema validator reads allowed request fields directly without rejecting accessor descriptors, so an allowed-field getter can execute before the later safety scan rejects the request. buildRecommendation also calls validateRequestClosed without a safety preflight.

review_findings.required_fix: Validate the complete graph before the first Object.freeze (or use a two-phase validate-then-freeze traversal). Add a nested invalid-descendant case asserting the parent and descendants remain unfrozen after rejection.
review_findings.reason: The exported deepFreeze freezes the current object before recursively validating descendant descriptors at lines 160-164. A valid parent with a descendant accessor/symbol can therefore throw after the parent has already become frozen, leaving caller data partially mutated.
